name: claude-replicant
description: Capture, validate, plan, and safely restore repository migration capsules.

interface.shortDescription: Safely migrate a selected Git repository.
interface.longDescription: Claude Replicant creates integrity-checked repository capsules, validates them, produces dry-run restore plans, and restores only to a new explicitly approved destination.
defaultPrompt: Back up a selected repository to a capsule store.
Plan a safe restore to a new destination.
